maturity_scale.L0: UNAVAILABLE: no provider or tooling present
maturity_scale.L2: OPERATIONAL: pipeline executes end-to-end on real artifacts
maturity_scale.L3: VERIFIED: automated tests exercise the pipeline

principle: maturity is never inflated; L5 requires real implementation + real use + failure test + regression test + independent review + documented limitations
